# Declared exceptions to the image structure invariants checked by
# .github/scripts/check-image-structure.sh. One per line:
#
#   <check> <image> <reason>
#
# checks:
#   prod-shell  prod variant may contain /bin/sh (bash and apk-tools are still
#               reported). Reason must say what execs the shell.
#   prod-root   prod variant may run as root (uid 0 or no USER set).
#
# A reason is required; an entry without one is ignored and the image is
# reported as if it had no exception. Keep this list short: every entry is a
# place the "shell-less, nonroot" promise does not hold.

prod-shell airflow              scheduler/worker subprocesses exec /bin/sh; busybox only
prod-shell bash                 the shell is the product: bash plus busybox utilities
prod-shell cassandra            bin/cassandra and its entrypoint are #!/bin/sh
prod-shell composer             Symfony Process runs git and package scripts through /bin/sh
prod-shell couchdb              /usr/bin/couchdb is a #!/bin/sh launcher
prod-shell erlang               erl is a #!/bin/sh wrapper around erlexec
prod-shell flink                launchers are #!/usr/bin/env bash scripts
prod-shell gitea                git hooks run through sh
prod-shell gradle               /usr/bin/gradle is a #!/bin/sh launcher
prod-shell kafka                KRaft initialisation entrypoint is a shell script
prod-shell keycloak             entrypoint /opt/keycloak/bin/kc.sh is a bash script
prod-shell kong                 kong CLI shebang chain needs /usr/bin/env + sh
prod-shell mariadb              entrypoint is a shell script
prod-shell maven                /usr/bin/mvn is a #!/bin/sh launcher
prod-shell mysql                entrypoint is a shell script
prod-shell neo4j                launchers are shell scripts; package hard-depends on bash
prod-shell opensearch           bin/opensearch is a bash script
prod-shell patroni              initdb popen()s /bin/sh (postgres family)
prod-shell postgres-slim        initdb popen()s /bin/sh (postgres family)
prod-shell pulsar               bin/pulsar is a bash launcher
prod-shell rabbitmq             sbin startup scripts are #!/bin/sh
prod-shell solr                 bin/solr is a bash launcher
prod-shell temporal-admin-tools operator toolbox image; interactive by design
prod-shell timescaledb          initdb popen()s /bin/sh (postgres family)
prod-shell tomcat               entrypoint /usr/bin/tomcat-entrypoint.sh
prod-shell zookeeper            entrypoint is a shell script

prod-root buildkit              buildkitd needs root for rootful builds
prod-root kaniko                kaniko executor must run as root to build images
prod-root kube-vip              manages VIPs; needs root for NET_ADMIN/NET_RAW
